---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something the app should do
labels: enhancement
---

**What do you want to do?**
The task you are trying to get done, in a sentence or two.

**What happens today?**
How you do it now, or what gets in the way.

**What would help?**
Your idea. Screenshots or examples from other tools are welcome.

You can write in any language, Vietnamese included.
